kurz: First cook at medium heat, then fry briefly at high heat until crisp. That way chips are soft inside and firm outside.
bild_im_kopf: Like primer and varnish: the first coat prepares, the second makes the hard, shiny layer.
was_passiert: In the first bath at about 160 °C, the inside cooks, the starch swells and the surface forms a thin skin. As it cools, this skin firms up. In the second bath at about 190 °C, the last water on the surface evaporates quickly, and the skin hardens and browns before the inside dries out.
warum_wichtig: Fried once, hot: dark outside, raw inside. Fried once, gently: cooked through but limp. Only separating the two solves both.
faustregeln: Use a thermometer: the temperature is the whole trick.
Small batches, otherwise the oil temperature drops a lot.
schritte: Cut the potatoes, soak them and dry them very thoroughly.
Fry at about 160 °C for 5–6 minutes until cooked but still pale.
Let them cool on a rack for at least 15 minutes.
Fry at about 190 °C for 2–3 minutes until golden brown.
Drain on a rack and salt straight away.

skala.name: 2nd bath: dry and brown the crust
